children: Drug developer City Therapeutics filed for an initial public offering in the US on Thursday.
The Cambridge, Massachusetts-based company plans to sell new shares in the IPO.
City Therapeutics will list on the Nasdaq under the symbol “CTY.”
Goldman Sachs, Jefferies, ​Stifel and ​Oppenheimer are the underwriters for the offering.
